title: How is Kim Jong Un connected to the first man on the Moon?
description: Three real photos connect Kim Jong Un to Neil Armstrong.
hook: How is Kim Jong Un connected to Neil Armstrong?

links.line: In 2018, Kim Jong Un crossed the border to shake hands with South Korea's president, Moon Jae-in.

image.file: File:Moon Jae-in in the Russian State Duma (2018-06-21) 07.jpg

links.line: Two months later in Moscow, Moon met Valentina Tereshkova, the first woman in space.

image.file: File:RIAN archive 837790 Valentina Tereshkova and Neil Armstrong.jpg

links.line: And in 1970, Tereshkova pinned a badge on the first man on the Moon, Neil Armstrong.
